headline: VNET Group Beats Third-Quarter EBITDA Estimates and Reaffirms Full-Year Outlook
summary: Chinese carrier-neutral data center provider VNET Group topped third-quarter EBITDA forecasts and maintained its full-year guidance, sending its shares surging.
why: VNET Group is one of China's leading internet data center service providers, serving major cloud and technology enterprise clients.

impacts.name: VNET Group
impacts.why: VNET shares rose after third-quarter EBITDA results exceeded Wall Street expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Quarterly earnings beat analysts' expectations and full-year guidance was confirmed.
